utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. Could you bring a drill and a few screwdrivers, and maybe help me sort the donations when you get here?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Absolutely — I’ll bring a drill and some screwdrivers, and I can help sort the donations when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the timing and where everything needs to go first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right — can you confirm the timing and the drop-off spot first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sure — I just need the time and exact drop-off spot, then I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might’ve missed the latest details; what’s the plan again?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m a bit fuzzy too, but I think folks were dropping off anything broken that could be fixed up. I can check the details and let you know in a minute.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Oren — that’d be great. I’ll hold off and wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word and remind folks about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — that’d really help. I’ll keep an eye out for any folks who can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll let people know and see who can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Dane—just bring whatever tools you can spare, and I’ll sort them into the drive bins.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll swing by with what I’ve got and drop it in the bins.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure thing—let’s keep it simple: I’ll check what’s still needed, and then we can set a time for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Eli — I’ll let the neighbors know and help line up the time once you’ve checked what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Quinn. I’ll check what’s needed and get back to you so we can pick a time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Sam — are we still on for the repair drive today, and what time should I bring the tools?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, we’re still on for today—thanks for checking. If you can bring the tools around 2 PM, that would be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ll bring them by 2 PM. Do you want me to grab anything else on the way?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — could you head to the community center and check the donation table? Then bring anything missing back to my place on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check the donation table at the community center and bring back anything missing to your place on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — could you help coordinate the volunteer sign-up and keep track of who’s available this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can coordinate the volunteer sign-up and keep track of weekend availability.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies list for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing — I’ll keep the list updated and let you know if we’re missing anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are bringing tools and spare parts over by the community hall later today.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds like a good turnout. I might stop by and see if they need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great, Rey — I’m sure they could use you. I’ll swing by too and see what still needs sorting.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I do anything—what’s the date and what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s this Saturday, and we’re fixing up the old bikes and a few school desks.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—this Saturday, old bikes and a few school desks. I’ll keep that in mind and check anything else before I help.
